## What's Changed

* Document macOS 14.0 as the minimum supported version and separate system compatibility failures from Accessibility and Screen Recording permission troubleshooting. ([#44](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/44)) by [@tisfeng](https://github.com/tisfeng)
* Preserve unnamed compact web action targets as buttons so icon-only controls retain usable `element_index` values. ([#45](https://github.com/iFurySt/open-codex-computer-use/pull/45)) by [@tisfeng](https://github.com/tisfeng)
